source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Send command: ipmitool sdr elist
Check sensor reading change when temperature increase or decrease.
2. Send command: ipmitool sensor list
Check sensor threshold(upper/lower warning/critical) match with the spec
3. Set fan speed lower than the warning and critical threshold
Check SEL when sensor reach to threshold

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Speed should have a normal change behavior.
2. All setting should be correct and match with spec.(including sdr type)
3. SEL should have a correct log when sensor reach to each threshold.
4. System should have correct behavior, like shutdown or change fan speed, when reach to threshold.
5. All SPD_FAN1_R~SPD_FAN16_R should get pass result.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES/no-risk supplies only static SDR and sensor lists; it neither changes fan speed nor reads SEL, proves sixteen channels, monitors thermals or restores closed-loop control.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED correctly identifies cooling risk and missing control contract but treats normal Project mapping, setpoints and recovery inputs as permanent blockage.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 788/2291 repeats YES/static reads; duplicate-code entry 1510/2291 is the independent orderly-restart case and preserves stale fan-output wording.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Its non-counting sequence-954 draft was inspected only as history; this review independently strengthens control-to-tach attribution, closed-loop/fail-safe evidence and paired-rotor thermal behavior.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-35 forbids replacing the required low-speed transition with read-only inspection, ED-36 treats maps and approved setpoints as readiness inputs, and ED-38 retains engineer verdict ownership.

original_test_intent: For every applicable SPD_FAN1_R through SPD_FAN16_R speed channel, drive the mapped fan control through approved lower-warning and lower-critical transitions, verify tachometer/SDR accuracy, SEL assert/deassert and platform cooling/protection response, then restore automatic control and prove thermal recovery.
original_method: The source calls for setting fan speed below warning and critical thresholds while observing IPMI sensor data. It does not define what suffix `_R` means, whether each tach channel has an independent control endpoint, or the safe method and recovery sequence.
manual_activity: An engineer resolves `_R`, maps all installed fan/rotor/zone/control paths, validates independent tachometer and emergency cooling, approves a sequential bounded fan-control plan and remains present with immediate restore or shutdown authority.
required_inputs: Meaning of `_R` plus Fan1~16 physical module, rotor, zone, tach sensor, SDR and control-endpoint map, including non-populated positions
BMC/CPLD/fan-controller firmware, normal automatic policy and supported vendor control interface
RPM/PWM units, normal range, lower-warning/lower-critical thresholds, hysteresis, event codes/severity and deassert behavior for each channel
Whether control is per rotor, per fan or per zone and the expected response of the paired rotor, peer fans and redundancy/fail-safe policy
approved system load, starting temperature, setpoint/ramp/dwell/maximum exposure, abort limits, emergency restore and cooldown
independent tachometer where feasible, CPU/GPU/DIMM/VR/PSU/inlet/outlet thermal telemetry, SEL/audit retention and recovery owner
safety_requirements: Do not lower fan speed, disable automatic control, alter thresholds or use an undocumented raw command before the exact map, limits and reversible control path are approved.
Exercise one approved channel or control group at a time unless Project SPEC explicitly qualifies a multi-fan fault; do not reduce all sixteen channels simultaneously by default.

Continuously compare commanded duty/control mode with independent tach feedback and monitor paired rotor, peer-fan compensation, controller faults, all critical temperatures, power and host/BMC health.

Abort and restore automatic cooling on zero or unstable RPM, unexpected paired-rotor response, fan redundancy loss, rapid thermal rise, threshold overshoot, controller/BMC loss, host instability or shutdown.
Preserve first SEL, controller, thermal, tach and audit evidence; do not clear logs, auto-retry or silently fall back to another control interface.
After each transition restore the approved automatic policy, verify the target and peer fans return to expected closed-loop behavior, and wait for all temperatures to stabilize before continuing.
agent_execution_scope: After approval, baseline all sixteen applicable `_R` channels, physical identities, control modes, RPM, thresholds, peer/paired-rotor behavior, SEL and critical temperatures.

Issue only the approved bounded vendor control for the selected channel or zone, collect synchronized command/duty, tach, temperature, controller, SEL, power and host evidence, then execute the pre-approved automatic-policy restore.
Produce separate warning assert, critical assert, deassert, compensation/fail-safe and recovery rows for every applicable `_R` sensor; static presence or a subset cannot satisfy the range.
Do not infer `_R`, invent raw control bytes, lower unapproved fans, modify thresholds, clear evidence, auto-retry or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Define `_R`, physical/rotor/zone/control mapping, applicability, setpoints, event/fail-safe expectations and whether any grouped control is coverage-equivalent.
Approve and supervise the load, sequential control, thermal envelope, abort, emergency cooling and recovery plan.
Assess any cooling, controller, thermal or system anomaly and issue per-channel plus overall DUT verdicts.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The read-only SDR/sensor lists are baseline-only, expose a password and disable host verification, do not perform the required low-speed action, retrieve SEL or demonstrate control-to-tach and restore behavior.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected authenticated IPMI for SDR/SEL evidence and only the Project-approved vendor fan-control interface with an explicit automatic-policy restore; pair it with independent tach and whole-platform thermal monitoring.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact SPD_FAN1_R~SPD_FAN16_R range, below-warning/critical action, high-level IPMI commands, script and 5/10-minute values remain; Project SPEC defines safe setpoints and dwell.

modernized_recommendation.status: PROJECT FAN CONTROL AND THERMAL SAFETY PLAN REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve every `_R` tach/control identity, baseline closed-loop cooling, sequentially apply approved bounded speed reductions, correlate lower-threshold SEL and compensation/fail-safe behavior, restore automatic policy after each channel and prove complete thermal recovery.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact chassis, fan module/rotor population, fan-zone design, controller/BMC/CPLD firmware, automatic cooling policy and system load.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record fan FRU/rotor mapping, BMC/CPLD/controller/SDR, vendor control client, telemetry and tachometer versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project fan topology and vendor fan-controller, SDR threshold, redundancy, fail-safe and platform thermal-limit specifications.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable control-to-tach identity, sequential rather than implicit all-fan reduction, independent feedback, peer/paired-rotor response and mandatory automatic-control restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Read-only enumeration, one fan, or an uncorrelated zone command is partial evidence and cannot establish sixteen independent `_R` threshold paths.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Suffix/map, supported control, thresholds/events, safe profile and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A control endpoint may affect multiple rotors or an entire zone; reducing cooling can create thermal damage or shutdown before an expected tach event is recorded.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may mark positions non-populated or use a zone-level supported control, but must record the exact command-to-sensor mapping, equivalent coverage and every unexercised individual path. Read-only observation or a subset cannot be presented as completion of all sixteen channels.
expected_evidence: Fan1~16 applicability plus physical module/rotor/zone/tach/SDR/control identity and `_R` definition
BMC/CPLD/controller/SDR versions, automatic-policy baseline, normal RPM/PWM, thresholds, hysteresis and event matrix
approved per-channel or qualified zone setpoint/ramp/dwell, load, thermal abort and emergency-restore plan
timestamped commanded control/duty, independent tach/RPM, paired/peer-fan compensation, critical temperatures, controller faults, power, SEL and host/BMC state
decoded lower-warning/lower-critical assert/deassert timing for every applicable `_R` channel
automatic-policy restoration, recovered target/peer fan behavior, stabilized temperatures, preserved first-fault evidence and engineer verdicts

review_improvement: Turns an unsafe generic fan reduction into a traceable sixteen-channel threshold/fail-safe matrix with explicit physical mapping, independent feedback and verified return to automatic cooling.
independent_technical_reasoning: A tach sensor threshold test must prove more than fan presence: the approved control must cause the intended physical rotor's RPM transition, the BMC must assert/deassert the correct event, the cooling policy must compensate as specified, and recovery must restore closed-loop thermals. Missing maps and setpoints are Project readiness data, while physical emergency authority and final verdict remain with engineers.
